role: XCTest suite for RecoveryScoreCalculator pure functions: z→percentile utility, the SWC-band zToRecoveryScore and its default ScoringParameters, Tier-1 HRV scoring with fallbacks and baseline-staleness penalty, Foster monotony/strain, readiness ACWR/capacity cases, ScoreBreakdown scoring-version stamping, and ScoreVerdict boundaries.
toplevel: Computed helper properties defaultConfig (ScoringConfiguration, age 40, training+sleep on) and baselineStats (ln-mean log(40), SD 0.3, CV 6, HR 58±3, 30 days).
